scientific_integrity: The theorem has a self-contained analytic proof supported by a standalone finite checker; finite numerical tests are not claims of infinite proof. Originality is assessed against identified primary and prior mathematical statements, not established as absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: Only standard unweighted broom-tree root polytopes with both branch and handle size tending to infinity.
Path Gumbel convergence is weak; no fine-scale moments in that regime.
An equivalent Gaussian-array extreme-value formulation elsewhere remains possible.
Independent mathematical and literature audit not performed.
title: Gaussian width trichotomy and critical edge localization in broom-tree root polytopes
